description_en: Queries the source ports of UDP traffic that are filtered out by the filtering policies for UDP reflection attacks on an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询指定的DDoS高防实例上被UDP反射攻击防护策略过滤的反射源端口
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-udp-reflect --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-i7m255640000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUdpReflect

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: indicates an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance. This is the default value.
ap-southeast-1: indicates an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例所属地域ID。取值：

cn-hangzhou（默认）：表示中国内地，对应DDoS高防（中国内地）实例。
ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地，对应DDoS高防（非中国内地）实例
parameters.name: region_id
